description: Source code implementing ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD encryption algorithms, including initialization, cleanup, sealing, and opening functions for both ChaCha20 and XChaCha20 variants, with associated data handling and cryptographic operations.

methods.name: aead_chacha20_poly1305_init
methods.description: Initializes the AEAD context with a key and tag length for ChaCha20-Poly1305.

methods.name: aead_chacha20_poly1305_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up the AEAD context (no operation).

methods.name: calc_tag
methods.description: Calculates the authentication tag for given inputs using Poly1305.

methods.name: chacha20_poly1305_seal_scatter
methods.description: Performs encryption and authentication (seal) with scatter support, handling extra input.

methods.name: aead_chacha20_poly1305_seal_scatter
methods.description: AEAD seal operation for ChaCha20-Poly1305 with scatter support.

methods.name: aead_xchacha20_poly1305_seal_scatter
methods.description: AEAD seal operation for XChaCha20-Poly1305 with scatter support.

methods.name: chacha20_poly1305_open_gather
methods.description: Performs decryption and verification (open) with gather support.

methods.name: aead_chacha20_poly1305_open_gather
methods.description: AEAD open operation for ChaCha20-Poly1305 with gather support.

methods.name: aead_xchacha20_poly1305_open_gather
methods.description: AEAD open operation for XChaCha20-Poly1305 with gather support.
